text:
Maya T: quick heads-up — during a canary run this morning I noticed a handful of customer email addresses in the runtime debug logs for the routing service. S3 path: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2024/11/route-debug.log. Not tokens, just full email strings. :eyes:
Chris L: how many? staging only?
Maya T: ~8 unique emails, all from a single canary batch, staging region. Canary flag `--debug-runtime` was accidentally left enabled for that run.
Raj P: ok scope sounds small — any downstream copies (kafka, metrics, alerts)?
Maya T: grep shows only that log file + one snapshot in ephemeral /tmp on the canary host. I did NOT find entries in metrics exporter or kafka.
Jordan K: stop log retention for that prefix and restrict S3 read for that key ASAP. @security-bot can you revoke public read and list?
security-bot: automated alert: created INC-2024-542; changed S3 ACL on s3://redwood-logs/canary/2024/11/route-debug.log to private. Notified owners.
Chris L: good. Can we snapshot the current file for forensics and then scrub the live copy? I can run scrub now if someone grants me temporary write.
Maya T: please snapshot first (copy to forensics bucket with restricted ACL), then scrub. Use this scrub command: ```python
import re
with open('route-debug.log') as f:
  for line in f:
    print(re.sub(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+","[REDACTED_EMAIL]", line))
```
Raj P: I'll create a short ACL ticket and add Chris as approver for the scrub run. Also rotate any keys that had access to the canary instance (list attached in ticket).
legal-team: quick Q from legal: do we have customer-identifiers beyond email in the logs? if so we may need to notify.
Maya T: no other PII found — no tokens, no SSNs, only email address strings and internal request ids.
legal-team: please preserve the forensic snapshot. We'll review for notification obligations. Tentatively no external customer notice unless we see derivable sensitive data.
Jordan K: communications — can we get a short internal blurb for GTM/CS so they can triage incoming customer questions?
Maya T: draft: "We detected staging debug logs that included a small number of customer email addresses from a canary run. The file has been secured and redacted; no tokens or production data were exposed. We're auditing and will follow up if we need to notify customers." Thoughts?
Chris L: LGTM, maybe add timeframe and that affected customers will be contacted only after legal confirms.
legal-team: agree to that wording; add contact point security@redwood.ai.
Raj P: action items: 1) snapshot -> CHRIS (now) 2) scrub live -> CHRIS (after snapshot) 3) rotate canary host keys -> RAJ (30m) 4) preserve snapshot for legal -> MAYA 5) draft internal comms -> JORDAN
Maya T: done, starting snapshot now. ETA 10m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
